source.excerpt: Shared as a shipping partner that leaves a lesson file behind after every revision round.

body:
## What it does

Works next to you on video work and product builds rather than handing over a one-shot answer. Every revision round closes with a short lesson file noting what changed, and the how-to visuals are laid out to show the steps in order. Good for lipsync-heavy clips and small iterations. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @Jon_Rose_ shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
